title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV in the Democratic Republic of Congo - Congo (Democratic Republic) (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Congo (Democratic Republic), Tuberculosis, Caritas Congo ASBL (CARITAS)This program has the following goals: Contribute to the reduction of 25% of TB related mortality by 2025. Ensure global care and treatment of all TB/HIV co-infected patients in DRC. The objectives of this program are: Detect by 2017 387,785 TB cases all forms in DRC. Enrol 95% of TB/HIV co-infected patients on ART by 2017. Maintain treatment success rate for bacteriologically confirmed cases of at least 90%. Treat successfully 75% of MDR-TB patients by 2017 (long regimen)
